name: io.github.Quorus-dev/quorus
title: Quorus
description: Shared rooms, messages, file locks and task claims for AI coding agents from any vendor.

environmentVariables.name: QUORUS_RELAY_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of your Quorus relay (default http://localhost:8080; `quorus relay` starts one).

environmentVariables.name: QUORUS_INSTANCE_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Your participant name in the relay's rooms.

environmentVariables.name: QUORUS_RELAY_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The relay's shared secret (local relays). Not needed if QUORUS_API_KEY is set or `quorus init` saved credentials.

environmentVariables.name: QUORUS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your own key on the relay, instead of the shared secret. Not needed if `quorus init` saved credentials.
